name: Kamishiro Souji
source: Souji is [url=https://vndb.org/c3132]Sayaka[/url]'s only trusted friend.[spoiler] They grew up together and have known each other for a very long time.[/spoiler] Nowadays, they are both attending painting lessons at [url=https://vndb.org/c7308]her father[/url]'s art studio. Souji also has a [url=https://vndb.org/c12875]younger sister[/url] that is at odds with Sayaka.
